Example: Anna / reads / a book / at night becomes Anna reads a book at night. Rule: Put the subject first, then the verb, then the object; put time or place last.
Right: Tom eats rice at noon. Wrong: Eats Tom rice at noon.
Now try this one. Put in order: "plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
